ink-black.$description: Ink Black — All text, all borders, all filled elements, icon strokes, footer background, the black showcase band. The structural dark

carbon.$description: Carbon — Input field borders and input text — functionally identical to Ink Black, kept as a token for form-state flexibility

helvetica-neue.$description: Primary typeface for everything readable. Weight 300 carries the massive 18rem display headlines — the light weight at extreme size lets the letters breathe inside the locked -0.03em tracking. Weight 400 handles body copy at 0.8125rem–0.875rem and short uppercase labels. 1.75rem serves as a mid-tier subhead. The 0.80 line-height on the display is critical: it stacks the giant letters tight enough to read as a single graphic block.

good-glyphs.$description: The actual product — the dingbat glyphs themselves rendered at full display scale. Only ever appears inside the black showcase band as proof that the font works at intended size. Not used for UI text.

pledge-mint-canvas.$description: Surface level 1: Base page background, all light sections, the default surface for cards and buttons

ink-black-band.$description: Surface level 2: Full-bleed dark section for showcasing the glyph font — the only non-mint surface
